title: StabilityBench: a Framework for Benchmarking Instability in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-turn interactions conditioned on 18 different first languages (L1) and measuring the Simulation Degradation Rate (SDR) and Flip Rate of correct model responses.
Mapping the 18 injected first languages (L1) to U.S. Census racial and ethnic categories to evaluate performance degradation and drift across racio-ethnic demographic proxies.
Injecting assertive versus mitigated conversational styles as stylistic and probabilistic gender markers to measure instability and degradation in model accuracy.

Varying educational register (high vs. low linguistic complexity) and injecting insurance status (insured vs. uninsured) in multi-turn interaction histories to proxy economic status and track task performance degradation.
